description.text: Garchomp Deck 30, a Japanese half deck released on 16 March 2012 with the Dragon Blade expansion, alongside Hydreigon Deck 30 for Dragon Blast. Its 30 cards, three of them holo (Gyarados, Garchomp and Blend Energy WLFM), include Garchomp with its pre-evolutions Gible and Gabite, and adding the powerful Garchomp of Dragon Blade makes it much stronger. A deck-modification guide showed how to build a Dragon deck of one's own with the two expansions.
